description: Caller volunteers a budget far too low for the scope. Polite decline, no figures spoken back, no referral.

turns: Hi, I'm Meena. I have a 3BHK in Hadapsar, about 1,200 sq ft, and I want a complete redesign with execution — kitchen, wardrobes, everything.
We have only about one lakh rupees set aside for the whole thing. Is that okay?
